notes.title: Phat Phrog Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26675641/1394bd309d1574e1da7e2a0e9c4f542d7d01268b.png[/img]

I've decided to change Phat Phrog from free to play to pay to play from Feb 1st 2023, the game will remain free for people who have previously downloaded the game 

Also in Q3 - Q4 2023 i will be updating Phat Phrog to have a landscape view and also have talents for each of the Phrogs that makes them unique and gives the player more control over the Phrogs including a slam skill that brings the phrogs down like a lead balloon so you can hit those logs easier

There's lot's planned for Phat Phrog in 2023!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26675641/0e3533d21686d1013c933aaa9731e7e89af3ad14.png[/img]

notes.title: PHAT PHROG - New Phlan & Phlai Costumes
notes.content:
Hey Guys

A new update has gone out for PHAT PHROG today that includes 8 new shiny costumes that can be unlocked via treasure chests in-game or via DLC

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26675641/0e3533d21686d1013c933aaa9731e7e89af3ad14.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26675641/1394bd309d1574e1da7e2a0e9c4f542d7d01268b.png[/img]

I've also changed the way treasure chests work, now when you hit a treasure chest in-game you will be given a treasure chest on the main menu to open

Treasure chests can also be purchased from the store via Steam

Also how cool is my Phlam plushie!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26675641/3349d5454bc221bd11ad6b5018d5531be556ffb2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26675641/9932bdaaf260ff4fe372a8e044afc22b50cb6f77.jpg[/img][/url]

Thanks very much for your support guys

I really appreciate it!

~Lee

notes.title: Phat Pigments Update
notes.content:
A new update has been applied to Phat Phrog, this update adds 8 pigments that can be unlocked from treasure chests in Phat Phrog, these pigments change the colour of Phlam and add another collectible element to the game

You can access the Pigments page by clicking the icon in the top right hand corner on the Main Menu

Also achievements should be working now

Thanks

Lee!

notes.title: We are Live & How To Play!!!
notes.content:
You can now download and play Phat Phrog for free on Steam!

I appreciate everyone for the support of getting Phat Phrog greenlit, if you download the game and like it then please leave us a review, it really helps.

You can also support us by purchasing the UNCAGED version of Phat Phrog as a DLC which will unlock all the costumes in the game (you can also unlock them ingame from treasure chests). The DLC is currently 30% off for the first week of launch!

Here's how Phat Phrog works!

Phlam gets points for bouncing up and down on coloured wooden logs, everytime you hit a log which is the same colour as the last one you hit then it will increase the score multiplier speed but if you hit a different colour it will reset the multiplier.

You can move left and right using either the left and right cursor keys, you can also use A and D, plus if you have a touch screen monitor you can click the left and right side of the screen to move left and right

There are also 3 really difficult challenges for you to attempt and an achievement for each one that you unlock

Leaderboards?

Yes there is a Phat Phrog global leaderboard to show who is the Phattest Phrog in the land!

Thanks again everyone and i hope you enjoy the game, head on over to the forums to leave some feedback and suggestions

~Lee ːsquirtyayː
